drafts_today.topic: Small Business Saturday: shop small, glow local (Sechelt one-woman shop)
drafts_today.text:
It's Small Business Saturday, and I'm about as small as they come: one woman, one table, a lot of Korean skincare.

If you're shopping small this weekend, I'd love to help you pick a gift for a woman who "has everything."

Who's on your list this year?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your Cats Health and Beauty logo card propped against a small pile of real RIMAN boxes (Dermatology First Package, Glow Up Lip Oil, Suamel Body Cream) on the kitchen table, window light, a kraft gift bag beside them. Simple square photo.
drafts_today.video_tip: 7-8 s, vertical or square: hand sets the logo card down (2 s), drops the three RIMAN boxes into the gift bag one by one (4 s), ties the ribbon (2 s). On-screen text: 'Shopping small? Hi, I'm small.'

drafts_today.text:
Coast friends: I'm back at Trail Bay Centre in Sechelt tomorrow, Sunday.

Sit down for a 15-minute mini-facial, try RIMAN Korean skincare on your own hands, and tell me where winter hits your skin first.

Come say hi 💛
drafts_today.picture_tip: You at home holding your Trail Bay poster (v7) next to the folded table banner, natural light, big smile. Plain wall behind you.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8 s selfie clip: 'See you tomorrow at Trail Bay!' while you hold up the Dermatology Booster EX, then the poster. On-screen text: 'Trail Bay Centre · Sun Nov 29'.

drafts_today.topic: Cyber Monday tip that costs $0: double cleanse the RIMAN way
drafts_today.text:
The best Cyber Monday skincare deal costs $0: cleanse properly.

1. Moisture Cleansing Oil on DRY hands and face
2. Add warm water till it turns milky, rinse
3. Snow Enzyme Cleanser EX, warm water rinse
4. Pat dry before anything else

Save this for tonight.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Flat lay on a bathroom counter: Moisture Cleansing Oil, Snow Enzyme Cleanser EX, a folded dry face cloth, soft morning light. Products in order left to right.
drafts_today.video_tip: 10-12 s: pump oil into dry palms (2 s), massage on face (3 s), splash warm water and show the milky emulsion (3 s), Snow Enzyme foam (2 s), pat dry with face cloth (2 s). On-screen text: 'The $0 Cyber Monday deal'.
